_meta.description: PULSE AI Coach scenario-to-domain routing map. Maps client situations to relevant knowledge domains and expert references. Multiple domains may fire simultaneously for complex scenarios.
_meta.usage: Read client context block → identify matching scenario(s) → inject relevant domain knowledge files into prompt Tier 2.

fat_loss_plateau.priority_check: Audit caloric accuracy first, then progressive overload stagnation, then logging drift. Check all three before adding complexity.
fat_loss_plateau.first_question: When did you last log your food for a full week without any gaps?

low_compliance.priority_check: Assess life context before prescribing harder protocols. Is this a motivation problem or an environment/stress problem?
low_compliance.first_question: Walk me through what a typical day looks like right now.

weight_loss_muscle_loss.priority_check: Check protein intake first, sleep second, training volume third.
weight_loss_muscle_loss.first_question: How much protein are you actually hitting on most days?

fatigue_poor_recovery.priority_check: Is this physical overtraining or life stress? Sleep hours vs. sleep quality. HRV trend if available.
fatigue_poor_recovery.first_question: How has your sleep been this week — hours and quality?

perimenopause_flags.priority_check: URGENT: name the cluster, validate the experience, point toward menopause-certified provider.
perimenopause_flags.first_question: How long have you been experiencing these changes? Have you talked to a provider about perimenopause specifically?

postpartum_return_to_training.priority_check: 6-week OB clearance is NOT return-to-sport clearance. Assess pelvic floor symptoms, birth type, and current phase.
postpartum_return_to_training.first_question: What type of birth did you have, and are you experiencing any symptoms during movement — leaking, pelvic heaviness, or pain?

prenatal_training.priority_check: Identify trimester. Watch for red flag symptoms. Maintain continuity over performance. No modifications needed for most movements in first trimester.
prenatal_training.first_question: How many weeks are you, and are you experiencing any symptoms during exercise?

stress_eating.priority_check: Address the stress first — not just the eating. Cortisol is the upstream cause. Willpower augmentation will not work.
stress_eating.first_question: What's going on in your life right now that's driving the stress?

burnout_low_motivation.priority_check: Distinguish physical burnout (performance decline, chronic soreness) from psychological burnout (motivational). Different interventions.
burnout_low_motivation.first_question: Is exercise feeling physically hard right now, or does it feel more like a mental block?

joint_pain_during_training.priority_check: Run ankle mobility test for squat pain first. Remove load before diagnosing. Load vs. capacity assessment.
joint_pain_during_training.first_question: Where exactly does it hurt, and when in the movement does it hurt most?

body_composition_stall.priority_check: Use InBody diagnostic table. Weight alone is misleading. Check fat mass vs. muscle mass independently.
body_composition_stall.first_question: When did you last do an InBody or body composition scan?

scale_obsession.priority_check: Reframe from weight to body composition. Lead with muscle. Scale is the worst single metric.
scale_obsession.first_question: Are you tracking anything other than the scale right now — measurements, how clothes fit, energy levels?

cardio_only_client.priority_check: The cardio trap conversation. Add resistance training minimum 2x/week. Protect muscle mass. Reframe around the marginal decade.
cardio_only_client.first_question: What does your resistance training look like right now?

new_client_goal_unclear.priority_check: Assess readiness stage before prescribing anything. A contemplation client needs a question — not a protocol.
new_client_goal_unclear.first_question: What's prompting you to want to change something right now?

client_trains_but_nutrition_poor.priority_check: One habit first. Habit stacking onto existing gym routine. Protein at breakfast is the starting point.
client_trains_but_nutrition_poor.first_question: What does breakfast look like on a typical training day?

senior_client_aging_concerns.priority_check: Marginal decade frame. Bone density. Sarcopenia prevention. Muscle as medicine.
senior_client_aging_concerns.first_question: What does your strength training look like right now, and how long have you been doing it?

glp1_medication_client.priority_check: GLP-1 clients are at highest risk for muscle loss. Protein-first eating + resistance training are non-negotiable. InBody tracking essential.
glp1_medication_client.first_question: Are you doing any resistance training alongside the medication?

sleep_poor_not_recovering.priority_check: Work through sleep optimization hierarchy in order. Start with consistent wake time and morning light before recommending any supplements.
sleep_poor_not_recovering.first_question: What time do you wake up in the morning — and is it consistent, or does it vary?

female_underfueling_athlete.priority_check: RED-S risk assessment. Irregular cycles, poor performance, stress fractures are red flags. Underfueling is not discipline.
female_underfueling_athlete.first_question: What does your food intake look like on a training day versus a rest day?

anxious_self_sabotaging.priority_check: Fixed mindset, cognitive reframing. Nervous system regulation tools. Identity vs. compliance framing.
anxious_self_sabotaging.first_question: Tell me about a time when things were going really well — what was different then?

milestone_hit_feeling_empty.priority_check: The goal was a destination. Identity coaching — who are you becoming, not just what did you achieve?
milestone_hit_feeling_empty.first_question: Now that you've hit this goal — who do you want to be in the next chapter?

weight_fluctuation_confusion.priority_check: Daily weight fluctuation is water, glycogen, food volume. Trend over 2–4 weeks is the signal. Normalize and redirect to trend.
weight_fluctuation_confusion.first_question: Are you weighing at the same time and under the same conditions each day?

diet_myth_question.priority_check: Evidence hierarchy. Evaluate against energy balance and protein adequacy. Don't validate myths to protect feelings.
diet_myth_question.first_question: What made you curious about that — where did you hear it?
